create.name: Cindy Glennon
create.bio:
Cindy Glennon is a yoga and meditation teacher on the North Shore of Massachusetts. She holds the 500-hour yoga teaching qualification, having trained first with Jacqui Bonwell and then with Willa Worsfold, and has further certification in yoga nidra, yin yoga and meditation from Sagel Urlacher, along with study of anatomy and functional movement. She is also a second-degree Reiki practitioner and has been taking part in a nature-centred mentorship with the Gaia Wisdom School. Before teaching she spent about twenty years in office roles in science and healthcare companies, after degrees in biology, neuroscience and public health.

Her teaching is gentle and exploratory, moving between body, breath and the subtler layers of experience, and she likes to tie practice to the seasons and the rhythms of nature. Alongside studio classes in her area, she teaches small groups at her home studio and gives private sessions for individuals and families. Her online library holds more than eighty recorded classes, from five-minute pieces to ninety-minute yin practices, sold singly, in themed series such as a seasonal vinyasa set and a yin chakra series, or as one all-access pass. Her guided meditations, including a yoga nidra practice, are free on Insight Timer.

courses.title: All Access Yoga Video Library
courses.description: One purchase opens her whole library of more than eighty recorded classes, over twenty-five hours in all. Styles include yin, vinyasa, breathwork, short targeted sessions and seasonal themes.

courses.title: Yoga Video Bundles
courses.description: Themed series of recorded classes sold as a set, among them a seasonal vinyasa series and a yin series moving through the chakras. Each bundle is a one-off purchase that can be downloaded.

courses.title: Private Yoga and Meditation Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one or family sessions shaped around each client's goals, drawing on yoga, meditation and simple ways of settling the mind. She also teaches small groups from her home studio.

free_resources.description: Her free guided meditations and yoga nidra practices on the Insight Timer app.
